title: K549: Multi-Asset VT Beyond SPY/GLD — Can Adding a Third Asset Improve the Portfolio?
references: DeMiguel, Garlappi, Uppal (2009) RFS: 1/N beats optimization
Asness et al. (2012) JFM: Risk parity fundamentals
Harvey, Liu, Zhu (2016) RFS: Multiple testing threshold (t>3.0)
K233: Three-Asset SPY/GLD/IEF — hurts Sharpe (DM p=0.004)
K219: Risk Parity NOT sig better (DM p=0.64)
verdict: WEAK POSITIVE: Some alternatives consistently better OOS but not statistically significant
conclusion: Tested 8 multi-asset portfolios + 2 risk parity variants against 50/50 SPY/GLD + 12/VIX benchmark. 7/7 alternatives had higher full-period Sharpe, but 4/7 passed DM test (p<0.05) and 0/7 passed Harvey threshold (|t|>3.0). Cross-OOS: 5 consistent winners (>=60% win rate). Confirms K233/K219: adding assets to 50/50 does not statistically improve risk-adjusted returns. Post-2020 SPY-TLT correlation break (K443) makes TLT addition particularly unreliable.
